name: Tubewell Installation /Pond Construction
benefit: Under this scheme, to promote the development of irrigation facilities, farmers are provided a 50% subsidy on the total cost for the construction of new tubewells or ponds, up to a maximum of ₹90,000/- per unit (limited to one unit per farmer).
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and must hold a valid Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease. 1. The farmer must confirm the availability of water in the concerned area. 1. A farmer is eligible for a subsidy for the construction of one tube well/pond.
